title: From Co-Design to Metacognitive Laziness: Evaluating Generative AI in Vocational Education
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure anything in terms of faith or religion. The evaluation focused on educational outcomes, such as lecturer workload, student confidence, exam performance, and student engagement patterns (e.g., dependency, cognitive effort).
models_tested: The paper evaluates a custom-built Generative AI proof-of-concept (POC) named 'StudyBuddy'. It was built on the Open WebUI framework using the vLLM inference server, but the specific underlying Large Language Model (LLM) is not named.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
